verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents a Code Sandbox, a secure, isolated cloud environment for running agent Python and shell code. Human-in-the-Loop approvals can also pause sensitive operations, such as deleting records or sending emails, before they run. Neither amounts to a dedicated test or staging environment, because agents still act through live connectors on real data. Missing for 10: a sandbox or staging workspace separate from production, mock or test data for connectors, a dry-run mode for agent runs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
